description: A white plastic model piece sits on the blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with a few small white blocks and bottle-shaped pieces nearby. The left hand stays low and steady on the bed near the model, while the right hand picks up a small white cube from the right, moves it left toward the top of the angled model piece, presses it into place, then loosens its grip and lifts slightly away, leaving the cube seated.
